scope: Append original, qualified work to YouTube only after supplementary research of all regular lanes. No changes to festival and residency.

YT_POSTS.titleZh: 《婆婆的手术费不见了，儿媳成了嫌疑人》
YT_POSTS.title: The Missing Surgery Money
YT_POSTS.whyZh: 一场家庭微短剧：婆婆的手术费失踪，照顾家人多年的儿媳被怀疑，丈夫却希望她先道歉。冲突从一个信封推到家人是否肯相信她。
YT_POSTS.whyEn: A family microdrama uses a missing envelope of surgery money to turn a household dispute into a question of trust.
YT_POSTS.metricsSrc: Original YouTube public counts; November 24 observed snapshot, not first-day metrics.

YT_POSTS.titleZh: 《烤出世上最悲伤鲫鱼饼的爷爷》
YT_POSTS.title: The Grandfather Who Makes the Saddest Fish-Shaped Pastries
YT_POSTS.whyZh: 短片把一位烤鲫鱼饼的老人放在故事中心。一个熟悉的日常动作本身就是情绪钩子；创作者在原帖明确标注人物为 AI 虚构。与电影人栏链接的两家见面一集不同。
YT_POSTS.whyEn: An elderly man making fish-shaped pastries anchors a distinct AI-fiction short. The everyday action is the emotional hook, separate from the creator’s directory film.
YT_POSTS.metricsSrc: Original YouTube public counts; November 24 observed snapshot, not first-day metrics.

YT_POSTS.titleZh: 《父亲不肯收生活费，却让儿子打开衣柜》
YT_POSTS.title: Father Refuses Help, Then Points to the Wardrobe
YT_POSTS.whyZh: 父亲靠修收音机生活，拒收儿子的生活费；儿子的工厂遇到困难后，他让儿子去看衣柜里的包裹。用一双补过的鞋和一个包裹表现父子关系。
YT_POSTS.whyEn: A family story that contrasts a father’s patched shoes and reluctance to accept an allowance with a bundle he tells his son to find when the factory is in trouble.
YT_POSTS.metricsSrc: Original YouTube public counts; November 24 observed snapshot, not first-day metrics.

YT_POSTS.title: After the Memorial Rite, Someone Stands Up for Her
YT_POSTS.whyZh: 家族祭礼后的饭桌上，亲属挑剔菜品，有人站出来替儿媳说话。把冲突留在饭桌和人物反应里；原帖资料注明为 AI 虚构微短剧。
YT_POSTS.whyEn: Criticism of the food after a family memorial rite turns into a conflict about how the daughter-in-law is treated. The production credits identify it as AI drama.
YT_POSTS.metricsSrc: Original YouTube public counts; November 24 observed snapshot, not first-day metrics.
